title: Displacing Congestion: Evidence from Paris
abstract: This paper shows that road-closing policies may have adverse short-run effects on pollution by reallocating traffic toward more congested roads. I study the impact of the 2016 closure of the Voie Georges Pompidou, a one-way expressway crossing downtown Paris, on traffic and pollution displacement. To do so, I rely on a difference-in-difference strategy based on the direction and the timing of traffic, which I implement on detailed road-sensor data. I show that the closure lowered average speed by over 15% on two sets of substitute roads: central streets nearby and the already congested southern ring road. Using air quality data, I show that NO2 emissions increased by 6% near the ring road and by 1.5% near local roads. The reduced-form results on traffic are quantitatively consistent with a calibrated model of shortest route choice, which allows me to recover the underlying rerouting patterns. Even though few displaced commuters diverted to the ring road, they triggered a massive pollution increase because of the U-shaped relationship between emissions and traffic speed. Overall, I estimate that up to 90% of the pollution cost was borne by lower-income residents around the ring road, who lived far away from the new amenity created by the closure and mostly outside the jurisdiction responsible for the closure decision. Finally, I study counterfactual closure scenarios to assess under which conditions those adverse effects could have been mitigated.
abstract_zh: 本文表明，道路封闭政策可能因将交通重新分配至更为拥堵的道路，而在短期内对污染产生不利影响。我研究了2016年关闭巴黎市中心一条单向快速路——乔治·蓬皮杜河滨快速路（Voie Georges Pompidou）——对交通和污染转移的影响。为此，我基于交通方向和时间，采用双重差分策略，并利用详细的道路传感器数据加以实施。我发现，此次封闭使两组替代道路上的平均车速下降了15%以上：附近的中心街道，以及原本已经拥堵的南部环城路。利用空气质量数据，我发现，环城路附近的二氧化氮（NO2）排放增加了6%，而附近地方道路的排放增加了1.5%。交通层面的简化式结果，在数量上与一个经校准的最短路径选择模型相一致，该模型使我得以恢复潜在的绕行模式。尽管只有少数被转移的通勤者改道至环城路，但由于排放与车速之间存在U形关系，他们引发了大规模的污染增加。总体而言，我估计，环城路周边多达90%的污染成本由低收入居民承担，这些居民远离封闭政策所创造的新公共空间，且大多位于做出封闭决定的管辖范围之外。最后，我研究了反事实的封闭情景，以评估在何种条件下这些不利影响本可以得到缓解。

title: When should urban roads be removed to lower carbon emissions?
